verdicts.reason: A breaks the product graphic. The cream circle is split off into the bottom-left corner as a leftover blob, and the can is now an orange outline on an orange background, so it almost disappears. The headline is too small for the canvas, the NEW pill floats alone in the top right, and the large empty gaps make the layout look scattered. B keeps the can-in-circle logo intact and the text is readable, but it is cramped: the circle is jammed into the top-left corner and almost touches the headline, which runs nearly to the right edge. The NEW and Try It buttons are oversized and compete with the headline, the subline sits under the buttons so the reading order is wrong, and the bottom third is empty.
